opId.description: A unique ID for this call. Reuse it only when retrying the same call.

prerequisite.description: For a new task: true when your task can't meet its acceptance criteria without this work and it adds nothing your task's goal didn't ask for. 10db files it once, whatever its size, unless a kind or risk needs a card.

costs.description: What the work costs: its size, the time it adds and any risk. The builder reads it when the proposal reaches them.

principle.description: For kind "principle": the rule itself. Without it, the body is used as the statement.

statement.description: One rule, phrased as an instruction.

kind.description: policy = must, heuristic = prefer, belief = context.

topicKey.description: A short stable key such as testing.no-sleeps; a later principle with the same key and scope replaces this one.

quote.description: The words this principle comes from, quoted exactly.

rationale.description: Why the rule holds, in a sentence.
